request.text: One clear short tactical breach horn. Two compressed clean low-mid synthetic brass pulses with a slight ascending urgency, a hard defined attack and a fast natural tail. Forward and legible on small speakers; no heavy sub-bass or backing score. One isolated cue with no dialogue, music, or background ambience.

rights.use: Paid plan permits commercial incorporation into a game, subject to terms and prohibited-use policy. Private project review only for isolated clips. Standalone distribution and public sample libraries are outside this review package.
